v: Tik sko tz'ib'ejb'at yab'ixal jun Lolonel sb'i t'ayex, haton jun tz'ak'an ko k 'inal. Aytax ek' t'a yichb'anel. Ix kab' sloloni. Ix kil wal ochi. Ix onh och k'elan t'ay, ix ko yamlan yet' ko k'ab'.

Ha jun tz'ak'an ko k 'inal chi', ix ch'oxchaj kila', ix kilanoch a onh tik, yuj chi' skak' testigoal ko b'a yuj, skalanpax eyab'i to a tz'ak'an ko k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Ha jun chi', aytaxon ek' yet' Dios, palta ix ch'oxji t'ayonh.
Yuj chi' a jun ix kil chi', jun ix kab' slolon chi', ha' skal t'ayex yik wach' junxonhej tzex aj a ex tik ket'ok. Yujto t'a wal yel wach'xo kak'an yet' ko Mam Dios yet' Jesucristo Yuninal.
Yuj chi' sko tz'ib'ejb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex, yik wach' ol te tz'akwok ko tzalajk'olal.
Skalb'at eyab'i tas alb'ilkan yuj Jesucristo t'ayonh to ha Dios sakil k'inal yaji, malaj wal jab'ok k'ik' k'inal t'ay.
Tato skala' to wach' kaj yet'ok, palta hanheja' ay onh to ek' t'a k'ik' k'inal, tonhej skal syal chi', a tas sko k'ulej manh yeloklaj.
Ha Dios sakil k'inal yaji. Yuj chi' tato a sakil k'inal sko b'eyb'alej, wach' kak'an yet'ok junjun onh, haxo schik'il Jesucristo Yuninal, ha' tz'ik'anel masanil ko chukal ayoch t'ayonh.
Tato skala' to malaj ko chukal, tonhej skak' musansatil ko b'a, manh yeloklaj tas skal chi'.
Tato t'a wal yel sko cha ko mulej ko chukal, ha Dios sukan sat smasanil, syik'anpaxel masanil tas manh wach'ok ayoch t'ayonh, yujto tojol toni, tz'elnhejk'och tas syala'.
Tato skala': Malaj b'aj ix och ko mul, ta xko chi, syalelk'ochi to wan kak'anoch Dios esalwumal. Tato icha chi', manh chab'iloklaj slolonel ku'uj.

Ex xajanab'il wu'uj, tzin tz'ib'ejb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex yik wach' maxtzak he k'ulej chukal. Palta tato ay b'aj tz'och ko mul, ay jun wan yak'anoch ko ti' t'a Dios, haton Jesucristo, te tojolnhej spensar.
Icha wal junok silab', icha chi' ix aj scham Cristo yuj stupanel ko mul. Manh yujoknhej ko mul a onh tik ix chami, palta yuj smul masanil anima ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yuj chi' ix chami.
Tato sko k'anab'ajej tas schekji ko b'eyb'alej yuj Dios, kojtakton Dios sik'lab'il syal chi'.
Tato skala' to kojtakxo Dios, palta max ko k'anab'ajej tas schekji ko b'eyb'alej yuj, esalwum onh syal chi', malaj jab'ok tas yel skala'.
Tato sko k'anab'ajej tas syal slolonel, t'a wal yel xajan ton Dios chi' ku'uj sik'lab'il. Ichaton chi' tz'aj kojtakaneli to ayonh och t'ay.
Tato skal icha tik: Ha in tik ay in och t'a Cristo, tato xko chi, yowalil sko b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al Cristo chi'.

Ex xajanab'il wu'uj, a jun cheknab'il swalb'at tik t'ayex, mantok hato tiknaik ol eyab'i. Yujto a jun cheknab'il tik, atax ix ex och yuninalok Dios ix alji t'ayex. Eyab'nakxo jun cheknab'il tik t'a peka' to yowalil sko xajanej ko b'a.

Palta swalxib'at jun cheknab'il tik t'ayex. Wan ko b'eyb'alan jun cheknab'il tik icha yutejnak sb'a Jesucristo, yujto a jun k'ik' k'inal ayoch t'ayonh, wan yek'kaneli, haxo jun sakil k'inal te yel wan yochkani.
Tato ay onh mach onh skala': Sakk'inalxo yaj in pixan, tato xko chi, palta tato wan schichonpaxoch ko k'o'ol t'a junok ketcreyenteal, ay onhto och t'a k'ik' k'inal syal chi'.
Tato sko xajanej heb' ketcreyenteal, ayonhxo och t'a sakil k'inal syal chi'. Yuj chi' malaj junok tas ayoch t'ayonh tz'ik'an ko juwieli.

Palta a heb' hanheja' schichonoch sk'o'ol t'a heb' yetcreyenteal, k'ik'alk'inalto yaj heb'. Icha wal junok mach sb'eyek' t'a k'ik' k'inal max yil-laj b'aj sb'ati, icha chi' heb', yujto juwinakel spensar heb'.
Tzin tz'ib'ejb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex a ex unin creyente exto, yujto ha Dios ix ak'an lajwok he mul yuj Jesucristo.

Tzin tz'ib'ejb'at t'ayex a ex ayxo eyoch creyenteal, yujto eyojtakxo Dios, jun aytaxon ek'i atax manto b'o jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Tzin tz'ib'ejb'at jun tik t'ayex ex creyente ayxo he tek'anil, yujto ix kan winh diablo t'a yalanh eyu'uj wet'ok. Tzin tz'ib'ejxib'at jun tik t'ayex a ex unin creyente exto, yujto eyojtakxo ko Mam Dios.

Tzin tz'ib'ejxib'at jun tik t'ayex ex ayxo eyoch creyenteal, yujto eyojtakxo pax Dios, jun aytaxon ek'i atax manto b'o jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha exxo creyente ex ayxo he tek'anil, ix ex tek'k'aji, yujto chab'ilxo slolonel Dios eyu'uj. Ix kan pax winh diablo t'a yalanh eyu'uj wet'ok. Yuj chi' tzin tz'ib'ejb'at jun u'um tik t'ayex.
Max yal ko xajanan jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' pax juntzanh tas ay t'ay. Tato sko xajanej, manh wanok ko xajanan ko Mam Dios syal chi'.

Ha heb' anima ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, a juntzanh snib'ej sniwanil heb' snib'ejochi. Snib'anxioch juntzanh tas wach' yilji heb'. Say heb' yik niwan tz'aj yelk'ochi. Ha juntzanh b'eyb'al chi', manh yikok ko Mam Dios, a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ay yiko'.
Ha jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' juntzanh snib'ejoch heb' anima chi' t'ay, ek'elb'anhej yaji. Palta tato sko k'ulej icha snib'ej Dios, pitzan onh t'a junelnhej yet'ok.

Ex xajanab'il wu'uj, ay onh ek' t'a jun slajwub' tiempoal. Ix kab' heyet'ok to ay jun ayoch ajk'olal t'a Cristo ol pitzwok cha'anh. Ilek nab'i, tzijtumxo heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay toxo ix pitzwi cha'anh. Yuj chi' kojtak to ay onhxo ek' t'a slajwub' tiempoal tik.

Ha t'a ko kal ix elta heb' chi', yujto toxonton manh ketb'eyumok heb'. K'inalok tato ketb'eyum heb', ix am ajnhej heb' ket'ok, palta ix elta heb' yik wach' scheklajeli to toxonton manh ketb'eyumok heb'.
Ha Cristo ak'annakoch Yespíritu Dios t'ayex ket'ok, yuj chi' kojtak jun k'ayb'ub'al yel ko masanil.
Yuj chi' tzin tz'ib'ejb'at jun in carta tik t'ayex, manh yujok to manh eyojtakok jun k'ayb'ub'al yel chi' tzin tz'ib'anb'ati, palta yujto eyojtakxo. Eyojtakpaxi to malaj junok es ayoch t'ay.

Ol wal t'ayex machtak heb' tz'esani: Haton heb' tz'alani to a Jesús manh Cristooc, syalelk'ochi to manh ak'b'ilok yopisio yuj Dios. Haton heb' chi' ayoch ajk'olal t'a Cristo, yujto max scha yab' heb' to ha Dios ay Yuninal, yuj chi' aypaxoch heb' ajk'olal t'a Dios haton Mamab'il.
Ha heb' tz'alani to a Jesucristo manh Yuninalok Dios, manh ayokoch ko Mam Dios t'a heb'. Haxo pax heb' tz'alan jun to a Jesucristo Yuninal Dios, ayton och Dios t'a heb'.

Yuj chi', a jun k'ayb'ub'al ix kab'i atax yik ix onh och yikok Dios, yowalil skak'nhejoch t'a ko k'o'ol. Tato icha chi' skutej kak'anoch t'a ko k'o'ol, junxonhej ol onh aj yet' ko Mam Dios, junxonhej ol onh aj pax yet' Yuninal.
Yalnakkan Dios to ol yak' ko k 'inal t'a junelnhej.
Tik tzin tz'ib'ejb'at t'ayex yuj heb' snib'ej ex yak'an musansatil.

Ha Espíritu ak'b'il t'ayonh yuj Jesucristo, aynhejkanoch t'ayonh. Yuj chi' manh yowalilok ch'ok mach tzonh k'ayb'ani, yujto a Yespíritu chi' tzonh k'ayb'an t'a masanil tasi. Ha jun k'ayb'ub'al syak' t'ayonh chi' te yel, malaj jab'ok es ayoch t'a skal. Yuj chi', yowalil junxonhej tzonh aj yet' Cristo, yujto icha chi' tz'aj yalan Yespíritu t'ayonh.
Haxo tiknaik ex xajanab'il wu'uj, yowalil junnhej tzonh aj yet' Cristo t'a masanil tiempo, yik wach' junk'olal tzonh aj t'a yichanh, manh ol onh k'ixwoklaj ayik ol jaxok.
Kojtak to a Jesucristo te tojol toni. Yuj chi' ichokab' tik tz'aj snachajel ku'uj: Tato tojol skutej ko b'eyb'al, yuninal onh ton Dios syal chi'.

Naek to te xajan onh yuj ko Mam Dios, yujto tzonh yaloch yuninalok. Yuninal onhxo ton jun. Ha heb' ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, max nachajel-laj yuj heb' tato yuninal onhxo Dios, yujto maj yojtakejel Dios heb'.
Ex xajanab'il wu'uj, yuninal onhxo Dios tiknaik. Maxto nachajel-laj ku'uj chajtil ol onh aj elk'ochok. Palta kojtak to ayik ol jax Jesucristo, lajan ol onh aj yet'ok, yujto ol kila' chajtil yilji.
Ha onh mach onh skak'och juntzanh swal tik yipok ko k'o'ol, kaktejekkan masanil chukal, yujto a Cristo malaj chukal t'ay.
Ha heb' sb'eyb'alan chukal, manhton wanok sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il Dios heb'. Yujto a heb' max k'anab'ajan juntzanh cheknab'il chi', a chukal sk'ulej heb'.
Kojtakxo to a Jesucristo ix ulek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yik syik'anel ko mul. Kojtak paxi to malaj jab'ok chukal ayoch t'ay.
Yuj chi' tato junxonhej kaj yet'ok, maxtzak yal sko b'eyb'alej chukal. Palta tato hanheja' ko b'eyb'alan chukal jun, syalelk'ochi to manh onh ayok ochlaj yet'ok, manto kojtakoklaj.
Ex xajanab'il wu'uj, malajokab' junok mach tzex ak'an musansatil. Tato tojol syutej sb'a junok mach, tojol ton spensar icha spensar Cristo, yujto a Cristo chi' tojol spensar.

Palta tato ay mach hanheja' sb'eyb'alan chukal, yiktaxon winh diablo yaji. Yujto a winh diablo chi', sk'ulejtaxon chukal winh t'a yichb'anel. Yujton jun chi' ix ulek' Yuninal Dios t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yik syak' lajwok smasanil tas sk'ulej winh diablo chi'.
Tato yel yuninal onhxo Dios, manhxo ol ko b'eyb'alej chukal, yujto k'exb'ilxo ko pensar yuj, haxo yik ayoch t'ayonh. Maxtzak yal pax ko b'eyb'alan chukal, yujto yuninal onhxo.
Icha chi' tz'aj scheklajeli, mach heb' yuninalxo Dios, mach pax heb' yuninalto winh diablo. Tato manh tojolok skutej ko b'eyb'al, tato max ko xajanej heb' ketcreyenteal, wal yel manh onh yikok Dios.
Ha jun cheknab'il swalb'at tik t'ayex, atax ix ex och yuninalok Dios, ix ex och ijan eyab'ani: Sko xajanejek ko b'a, xchi jun cheknab'il tik.

Yuj chi' max yal-laj kutan ko b'a icha yutejnak sb'a winhaj Caín. Ha winh chi', a winh diablo ay yik winh, yuj chi' smilnakcham winh yuk'tak winh. Icha chi' yutejnak sb'a winh, yujto manh tojolok sb'eyb'al winh, haxo winh yuk'tak winh chi', tojol sb'eyb'al winh.
Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', manh eyak' sat he k'o'ol tato tz'och heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik ajk'olal t'ayex.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, yik onh chamel, haxo tiknaik, toxo ix ak'ji ko k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Kojtak to ix ko cha ko k 'inal tik yujto sko xajanej ko b'a yet' heb' ketcreyenteal. Tato max ko xajanej ko b'a yet' heb', yik onhto chamel syal chi'.
Tato hanheja' schichonoch ko k'o'ol t'a heb' ketcreyenteal, mak'umcham anima onh t'a yichanh Dios. Palta kojtak to malaj junok mak'umcham anima ay sk'inal t'a junelnhej.

Kojtak chajtil tz'aj onh xajanan Dios to ix yak'och sb'a Jesucristo t'a yol sk'ab' chamel ku'uj. Yuj chi' yowalil ichokab' ta' skutej ko xajanan heb' ketcreyenteal, ta syala' b'ekanokab' ko k'o'ol ko cham yuj heb'.
K'inalok ay tas ay t'ayonh, haxo skilan junok ketcreyenteal te meb'a', tato malaj jab'ok tas skak' t'ay, manh xajanok ko Mam Dios ku'uj syal chi'.
Ex xajanab'il wu'uj, manh tonhejok skal yet' ko ti' to sko xajanej ko b'a. Yowalil tzonh kolwaj t'a heb' ketcreyenteal. Icha chi' skutej ko ch'oxaneli to t'a wal yel sko xajanej ko b'a.
Tato sko xajanej ko b'a, kojtak to yik onhxo jun k'ayb'ub'al te yel. Tato icha chi', manhxa ko xiwk'olal t'a yichanh Dios
ayik sko na'ani to ay ko mul yuj junok tas chuklaj ix ko k'ulej. Ha Dios ek'to yojtak t'a kichanh. Wal yel, A' tz'ojtakaneli yujto yojtak smasanil.
Yuj chi', ex xajanab'il wu'uj, tato kojtak to wach' ko b'eyb'al t'a yichanh Dios, max onh xiw ko lesalwi t'ay.
Tato icha chi', yalnhej tas sko k'an t'ay, ol yak' t'ayonh, yujto sko k'anab'ajej scheknab'il, wan ko k'ulanpax icha tas scha sk'o'ol.
Syal scheknab'il icha tik to skak'och Yuninal t'a ko k'o'ol, haton Jesucristo. Sko xajanej pax ko b'a junjun onh icha ix yutej yalan t'ayonh.
Tato sko k'anab'ajej juntzanh scheknab'il chi', junnhej kaj yet'ok, junnhej pax yaj ket'ok. Kojtak to aynhejoch t'ayonh, yujto yak'nak Yespíritu t'ayonh.

Ex xajanab'il wu'uj, tato ay heb' tz'alani to a yik Dios jun syalel heb', manh he cha eyab' t'a heb' t'a elanhchamel. Yowalil tze b'ab'laj ak'ej prowal heb' tato yel a slolonel Dios tzek' yalel heb'. Yujto tzijtum heb' tz'esan wan yek' t'a jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik, stz'akan yaloch sb'a heb' schekab'ok Dios.

Palta ol wal t'ayex chajtil tz'aj kojtakaneli tato yel ayoch Yespíritu Dios t'a heb'. Tato syal heb': Ha Jesucristo ul yak'nakoch sb'a animail, tato xchi heb', haton heb' chi' ayoch Yespíritu Dios t'ay.

Palta a pax heb' manh ichok ta' yalan yuj Jesús, malaj Yespíritu Dios ayoch t'a heb' syal chi', yujto lajan spensar heb' yet' jun ayoch ajk'olal t'a Cristo. Eyab'nakxo to a jun ajk'o'ol chi' t'ay, yowalil ol pitzwok cha'anh. Ha tiknaik, ayxo heb' lajan spensar icha ol yutok sb'a chi'.
Ex xajanab'il wu'uj, yik onhxo Dios tiknaik. Ayxokan heb' tz'esan chi' t'a yalanh ku'uj, yujto a Yespíritu Dios ayoch t'ayonh, ek'to spoder t'a jun ayoch t'a heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ha heb' tz'esan chi', yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik yaj heb'. Yuj chi' anhej juntzanh yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik syal heb'. Haxo heb' yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik scha yab' heb' t'a heb'.

Palta a onhxo tik, yik onhxo Dios. Yuj chi' a heb' yikxo Dios ket'ok, syak'och schikin heb' t'a tas skala'. Haxo heb' manh yikok Dios jun, max yak'ochlaj schikin heb' yab'an t'ayonh. Icha chi' skutej kojtakaneli, mach heb' ayoch Espíritu yel syal t'ay, mach pax heb' to a espíritu tz'esan ayoch t'ay.

Ex xajanab'il wu'uj, ko xajanejek ko b'a junjun onh, yujto a b'aj sko xajanej ko b'a chi', a t'a Dios skoti. Tato sko xajanej ko b'a, yuninal onhxo Dios. Tato icha chi', wal yel kojtakxo Dios chi' syal chi'.
Tato max ko xajanej ko b'a, wal yel manto kojtakok Dios chi' syal chi', yujto ha Dios chi' sxajanan taxon anima.
Ix sch'ox Dios to xajanab'il onh yuj, yujto ix schekkot jun pitanh Yuninal, ix ul yak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' chamel t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yuj yak'an ko k 'inal t'a junelnhej.
Icha tik tz'aj scheklajeli to t'a wal yel xajan onh yuj Dios: Manhok onh ix ko b'ab'laj xajanej Dios, palta to A' ix onh xajanani ayik ix schekankot Yuninal ul yak'cham sb'a stojolok ko mul.
Ex xajanab'il wu'uj, tato icha chi' ix aj onh xajanan Dios chi', yowalil sko xajanej ko b'a junjun onh.
Wach'chom malaj junok mach ix ilan Dios junelok, palta tato sko xajanej ko b'a, aynhejoch Dios chi' t'ayonh syal chi', yuj chi' jab'jab'il scheklajel sk'olb'al Dios chi' t'ayonh
Yuj Yespíritu ix yak'och kajan t'ayonh, yuj chi' kojtak to ayonh och t'ay, aynhejpaxoch t'ayonh junjun onh.
Ha onh tik kilnak wal Yuninal Dios, yuj chi' skak' wal testigoal yuj to a ko Mam Dios chekjinakkot Yuninal chi' yik tzul skolel heb' anima ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Tato a onh skala': Ha Jesús Yuninal ton Dios, tato xko chi, ha Dios ayoch t'ayonh, aynhej onh pax och t'ay.

Skak'anoch t'a ko k'o'ol to ha Dios xajan onh yuj. Kojtak wal jun tik sik'lab'il yujto ha Dios chi' sxajanan taxon anima. Yuj chi' tato sko xajanej ko b'a a onh tik, ay onh ton och t'ay syal chi', aynhejpaxoch t'ayonh.

Icha chi' tz'aj swach' tz'akwi ko xajanan ko b'a, yik wach' ayik ol ja sk'ual sch'olb'itaj yaj heb' anima, manh ol onh xiwlaj t'a yichanh Dios, yujto icha sb'eyb'al, icha chi' skutej ko b'eyb'al t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Tato yel sko xajanej Dios, maxtzak onh xiwlaj, yujto ayik sko xajanan Dios chi', tz'ik'jiel ko xiwk'olal. Tato tzonh xiwi, syalelk'ochi to xiwnak onh t'a jun ya'elal ol kot yuj yowal sk'o'ol Dios. Yuj chi' a heb' tzato xiwi, ayto palta stz'akwi xajanan Dios chi' heb'.
Sko xajanej Dios tiknaik, yujto A' ix onh b'ab'laj xajanani.

K'inalok tato skala' to xajan Dios ku'uj, palta schichonpaxoch ko k'o'ol t'a junok ketanimail, kesnhej syal chi'. Tato max ko xajanej heb' ketanimail skiloch chi', ¿tas wal ol kutok ko xajanan Dios max kilochlaj?
Yuj chi' yak'nakkan jun scheknab'il t'ayonh tz'alan icha tik: Ha mach xajanan Dios, yowalil xajanej heb' yetanimail, xchi.
Tato skak'och t'a ko k'o'ol to a Jesús haton Cristo, yuninal onhxo Dios syal chi'. Tato sko xajanej junok anima, hanhejtona' sko xajanej heb' yuninal jun anima chi'.
Yuj chi' kojtak to sko xajanej ko b'a a onh yuninal onh Dios tik, tato sko xajanej Dios, sko k'anab'ajanpax tas syala'.
Tato t'a wal yel sko xajanej Dios, sko k'anab'ajej scheknab'il. Ha juntzanh scheknab'il chi', manh ajaltakok ko k'anab'ajani.
Ha juntzanh chukal ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, kannakxo t'a yalanh kuj a onh yuninal onhxo Dios tik. Yujto skak'och Dios t'a ko k'o'ol, yuj chi' skan juntzanh chi' t'a yalanh ku'uj.
Anhej heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol to a Jesús Yuninal ton Dios, anhej heb' chi', syal skan jun chukal chi' t'a yalanh yuj.

Ha Jesucristo ulnakek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ul yak'annak bautizar sb'a. Elnak pax schik'il. Manh tonhejok ul yak'nak bautizar sb'a, elnak pax schik'il. Ha Yespíritu Dios syak' testigoal sb'a yuj, to Yuninal ton Dios. Ha Yespíritu chi', te yelnhej syala'.
Syak' testigoal sb'a Espíritu yuj. Ay pax chab'xo syak' testigoal sb'a yuj, haton sbautismo yet' schik'il ix eli. Ha oxe' tik junlajan scha'an sb'a yalani to a Jesucristo Yuninal ton Dios.
Sko cha tax kab' tas syal heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, okxom wal tas syal Dios ek'alxo yelk'ochi. Ha wal lak'an ix ak'an testigoal to Yuninal.

Ha onh skak'och Yuninal Dios t'a ko k'o'ol, kojtak sik'lab'il to yel syal Dios yuj Yuninal chi'. Haxo heb' max ak'anoch Yuninal chi' t'a sk'o'ol, wan yalan heb' to syesej Dios, yujto max yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol tas syal yuj Yuninal chi'.
Haton jun tik yalnakkan Dios to syak' ko k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Yujnhej Yuninal syak' jun ko k 'inal chi'.
Yuj chi', tato ayxo och Yuninal Dios t'ayonh, ayxo ko k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Haxo heb' malaj Yuninal Dios chi' t'ay, malaj sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej.
Tzin tz'ib'ejb'at jun tik t'ayex, a ex ix eyak'och Yuninal Dios t'a he k'o'ol, yik wach' ol nachajel eyu'uj to ay he k 'inal t'a junelnhej ket'ok.
Yuj chi' junk'olal tzonh lesalwi t'a Dios, yujto kojtak to yalnhej tas sko k'an t'ay, ol yab'i, tato sko k'an icha snib'ej.
Kojtak to ha' tz'ab'an ko lesal. Yuj chi' kojtak paxi to ha' tz'ak'an tas sko k'an t'ay.

K'inalok tato tzeyil junok ketcreyenteal wan sk'ulan junok chukal, palta manh yikoklaj chamel jun chukal chi', tato tzex lesalwi yuj, haxo Dios ol ak'an sk'inal. Palta ay chukal tojolnhej ko cham yuj. Max wal-laj t'ayex tato tzex lesalwi yuj juntzanh heb' sk'ulan jun chukal chi'.
Masanil juntzanh chukal, mul t'a sat Dios. Palta ay juntzanh chukal max onh chamlaj yuj.
Kojtak tato yel yuninal onhxo Dios, maxtzak ko b'eyb'alej chukal, yujto a Yuninal Dios tzonh tanhwani. Yuj chi' max yal onh yixtan winh diablo.
Kojtak to yik onhxo Dios. Haxo masanil heb' yikto yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ayto'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh diablo.

Hanhejtona', kojtak to ulnakek' Yuninal Dios t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha ix ak'an jakwok ko pensar, yik wach' skojtakejel Dios te yel. Yuj chi' a tiknaik, ayonhxo'och yet' jun te yel, haton Jesucristo Yuninal. Ha jun Yuninal chi', haton Dios te yel. Ha tz'ak'an ko k 'inal t'a junelnhej.
Yuj chi', ex xajanab'il wu'uj, manh eyak'och he pensar t'a juntzanh komon Dios.
